name: test.mq5
summary: This EA is a position management utility that monitors open positions and applies risk-based profit/loss closing and trailing stop logic. It does not open any new positions itself, only manages existing ones by closing when profit/loss thresholds are hit or adjusting stop losses with a trailing mechanism. It acts as an automated trade manager rather than a strategy-based trading system.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个持仓管理工具，监控已有仓位并根据设定的盈利/亏损百分比阈值自动平仓，同时应用移动止损逻辑来跟踪价格变动。它本身不开启任何新仓位，仅对已有仓位进行管理，属于半自动交易管理工具。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是风险管理与持仓保护，而非自主交易信号生成。入场条件方面，该EA完全不具备自主开仓功能，仅依赖用户手动或其他EA建立的仓位进行管理。出场条件包括两种：当持仓盈利达到账户余额的ProfitPercentage百分比时自动平仓锁定利润，或当亏损达到RiskPercentage百分比时止损平仓。仓位管理方面，EA不涉及仓位规模的计算或调整，仅对已有仓位进行止损和止盈的修改操作。资金管理方面，使用账户余额百分比来定义风险和利润阈值，这种方式比固定点数更灵活，能随账户规模自适应调整。移动止损逻辑会在价格向有利方向移动时逐步上移（买入）或下移（卖出）止损位，但限制了止损位不超过开仓价格，确保盈利仓位不会因追踪止损回撤而转为亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is risk management and position protection rather than autonomous trade signal generation. Regarding entry conditions, the EA completely lacks the ability to open positions on its own and relies entirely on manually established or other EA-initiated positions for management. Exit conditions include two scenarios: automatic position closing to lock in profit when the floating profit reaches the ProfitPercentage threshold of account balance, or stop-loss closing when the loss reaches the RiskPercentage threshold. In terms of position sizing, the EA does not calculate or adjust position sizes; it only modifies stop-loss and take-profit levels of existing positions. For money management, it uses account balance percentages to define risk and profit thresholds, which is more flexible than fixed pip values as it adapts to the account size. The trailing stop logic progressively moves the stop-loss in the favorable direction as price advances, while capping the trailing stop at the entry price to ensure profitable positions do not revert to losses due to trailing adjustments.

parameters.name: RiskPercentage
parameters.description: 每笔交易的风险百分比，达到此亏损比例时平仓
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage per trade; closes position at this loss ratio

parameters.name: ProfitPercentage
parameters.description: 每笔交易的盈利百分比，达到此盈利比例时平仓
parameters.description_en: Profit percentage per trade; closes position at this profit ratio

parameters.name: TrailingStopPoints
parameters.description: 移动止损点数，用于跟踪价格调整止损位
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop points for adjusting stop loss with price

pros: 使用账户余额百分比设定风险和利润阈值，能自适应不同账户规模
移动止损逻辑限制止损位不超过开仓价，确保盈利仓位不会回撤至亏损
代码结构简洁清晰，易于理解和修改
同时支持买入和卖出仓位的双向管理
pros_en: Uses account balance percentage for risk and profit thresholds, self-adapting to different account sizes
Trailing stop logic caps stop-loss at entry price, ensuring profitable positions cannot revert to losses
Clean and simple code structure that is easy to understand and modify
Supports both buy and sell position management with bidirectional trailing logic
cons: 完全缺乏自主开仓能力，仅作为持仓管理工具而非完整交易策略
盈利/亏损计算使用Point()而非实际合约价值，在非标品种上可能导致阈值判断不准确
移动止损点数未考虑品种的最小止损距离限制（StopsLevel），可能因止损距离过近被拒绝
未进行New Bar检测，每个Tick都会执行全部仓位检查，在高频Tick环境下可能造成不必要的性能开销
缺乏对PositionModify和PositionClose操作结果的错误检查和处理
cons_en: Completely lacks autonomous position-opening capability, functioning only as a position management tool rather than a complete trading strategy
Profit/loss calculation uses Point() instead of actual contract value (tick value/lot size), which may produce inaccurate threshold judgments on non-standard instruments
Trailing stop points do not account for the symbol's minimum stop level (StopsLevel), potentially causing modification rejections due to stops being too close
No new bar check is performed, meaning all position checks run on every tick, causing unnecessary performance overhead in high-frequency tick environments
Lacks error checking and handling for PositionModify and PositionClose operation results
improvements: 使用SymbolInfoDouble(SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE)和实际手数来计算盈亏金额，替代当前不准确的Point()计算方式
添加StopsLevel检查确保修改后的止损距离满足经纪商最小止损距离要求，并添加交易操作结果的错误处理
improvements_en: Use SymbolInfoDouble(SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE) with actual lot size for profit/loss calculation instead of the inaccurate Point()-based approach
Add StopsLevel validation to ensure modified stop-loss meets the broker's minimum stop distance requirement, and implement error handling for trade operation results

risk_points: 盈亏计算使用Point()而非真实合约价值，可能导致在非标品种上阈值判断失准，提前或延迟平仓
未检查StopsLevel限制，移动止损修改可能被服务器拒绝而无任何提示
每Tick执行全部仓位遍历，在极端行情下可能导致止损修改延迟
risk_points_en: Profit/loss calculation using Point() instead of real contract value may cause inaccurate threshold judgments on non-standard instruments, leading to premature or delayed position closing
No StopsLevel check means trailing stop modifications may be silently rejected by the server without any notification
Full position traversal on every tick may cause stop-loss modification delays during extreme market conditions

summary_en: This EA is a position management utility that monitors open positions and applies risk-based profit/loss closing and trailing stop logic. It does not open any new positions itself, only manages existing ones by closing when profit/loss thresholds are hit or adjusting stop losses with a trailing mechanism. It acts as an automated trade manager rather than a strategy-based trading system.
